Greater Healing Bottle

You swallow the strong draught and feel warmth spread deep into the hurt.

Rules

- ID: item-greater-healing-bottle - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: Inventory d4 - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

Use @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d719e1776cec64e8.JournalEntryPage.5fce3ed6d7178857]{Use a Healing Potion}: restore 10 HP before Life resistance, capped by missing HP. The giver needs a free hand and spends a Maneuver; another recipient spends a Reaction unless at 0 HP. Check the bottle’s inventory die after use; the final use still works.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 50 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
